sentences.text: ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP 2.

Ujjawal Jain D/o Late Shri Shanti Lal Jain, R/o 203,
 Second Floor, Sri Ram Apartment, Sector No. 14, Tehsil  Girwa, District Udaipur.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Deepak Menaria For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/04/2024 1.

During the pendency of the instant criminal misc. petition, the petitioner has received the sale consideration from the private respondents and accordingly a sale-deed got executed before the competent authority, as such now nothing survives for consideration before this Court in the matter as the cause of action has ended up.
The amount has been received by the vendor and the possession of the property has been delivered to the purchaser-complainant.
2. In this view of the matter, the instant criminal misc. petition is allowed.

The FIR No.197/2022 dated 18.05.2022 registered at Police Station Saveena, District Udaipur for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468 and 506 of the IPC is hereby [2024:RJ-JD:16455] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-3226/2022] quashed and set aside.

The SHO, Saveena, District Udaipur is directed to prepare a Negative Final Report to this effect and the same shall be submitted in the Court of Judicial Magistrate within next 30 days after receipt of a copy of this order.
